signed_payload:
[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 240
- Description: Fix GAS shadowed processNonAgl4Transactions + book 3 AGL8 Sacred Earth bags
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/609
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/611
  
  Details:
  Closed out the Cory / Sacred Earth Farms settlement by fixing the GAS pipeline that books non-AGL4 sales, then verifying every leg against the ledger.
  
  ROOT CAUSE (two compounding defects)
  1. processNonAgl4Transactions was defined TWICE in GAS project 1duQFfTO0Pj0lC4tPVNmMOhNOS1GvJgzqVxXbsEDu-eqt_64DwxvrOVyl. telegram_webhook_listener.js held a wrapper that UrlFetchApp'd a dead /a/macros/agroverse.shop/ URL and swallowed the 404 in a bare catch. GAS resolved to the wrapper, so the real implementation (sales_update_managed_agl_ledgers.js) had NEVER executed. Symptom: HTTP 200, ~62s, zero rows written, no exception.
  2. Behind it, two live defects in the real implementation: an unguarded sendNonAgl4TransactionNotification() call placed AFTER the legs/ACCOUNTED were written (any throw would abort the loop and strand later rows), and a schemeless SOURCE_SHEET_URL ('docs.google.com/...') passed to SpreadsheetApp.openByUrl(), which requires an absolute URL.
  
  WORK
  - PR #609: removed the shadowing wrapper, with a NOTE preventing reintroduction.
  - PR #611: wrapped the notification call in try/catch (booking is durable before it), and corrected SOURCE_SHEET_URL to https://.
  - Deployed via the blessed scripts/deploy_gas_project.py path; published version 29 and repointed deployment AKfycbwh35... so the callers' URL now serves v29 instead of redirecting to a Google login.
  
  VERIFICATION (not assumed)
  - QR Code Sales rows for 2024PAULO_20250804_19 / _21 / _22 now ACCOUNTED, Ledger Lines 209-211 / 212-214 / 215-217.
  - AGL8 Transactions grew 208 -> 217 rows (+9), read back at D206:F220 and confirmed as three exact -1 pouch / +17 USD / +1 tree triples.
  - Idempotency guard proven: second trigger returned HTTP 200 in 2.68s (vs 62s) and appended zero rows; sheet ends at row 217.
  - All four QRs report qr_status SOLD.
  - Corrected a bad AGL8 spreadsheet ID used in earlier diagnosis (the real one is from Shipment Ledger Listing row 7).
  
  OUTCOME
  19/19 Cory bags booked at USD 17 = USD 323 settlement. USD 161.50 received (50%); USD 161.50 remains outstanding. No duplicate bookings, no TDG issued, no production deploy, no money moved.
  
  RESIDUAL (not fixed, flagged)
  - processTokenizedTransactions shows the same duplicate-wrapper pattern in telegram_webhook_listener.js.
  - GAS project has no GCP project bound, so clasp logs fails ("GCP project ID is not set") and execution logs are unreachable - this is why the no-op took a day to isolate.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 400.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
